description: This file defines a React component for displaying product details, including fetching product data via API, rendering product information, and enabling add-to-cart functionality on a storefront website.

methods.name: formatInstant
methods.description: Formats an ISO instant string into a human-readable date/time string with ISO format, or returns a placeholder if invalid or undefined.

methods.name: getPrimaryName
methods.description: Retrieves the primary (most prominent) name from a product's descriptions array.
